tasks.title: T8-US-001: Audit and extend the relationship-type registry for the new domains
tasks.description:
As an ontologist, I want every edge the new domains need to be registered before any blueprint mints it, so new data round-trips through the linkers, Neo4j, and Datalog instead of producing orphan edges.

Acceptance criteria (all must be met before marking complete):
- Audit the four new domains (sports/games, science/tech/inventions, material culture/dress, living traditions/nature) and list the signature relationships each needs; reuse existing registered :TYPEs wherever they fit (LOCATED_IN, ORIGINATES_FROM, DERIVED_FROM, INFLUENCED_BY, VARIANT_OF, CREATED_BY, MADE_OF, PRECEDES/FOLLOWS, CONTEMPORARY_WITH, PART_OF_PERIOD, INSTANCE_OF, SUBCLASS_OF, etc.)
- Register only the genuinely new :TYPEs in src/pinakes_engine/ontology/registry.py, each with its Dimension, domain/range :LABEL tokens, and symmetric/transitive flags set correctly
- Wire each new :TYPE into the linker that should emit it and into the Datalog rule layer so its closure (if transitive/symmetric) is materialised; validate_type accepts every new type and the metrics dimension buckets account for it
- No new dimension is introduced (the four valid axes stay temporal/geographic/linguistic/genetic, plus the existing structural group); justify each addition in a one-line description on the RelationType
- Tests pass (pytest) — cover registration, validation, and linker emission for the new types
- Lint passes (ruff)
- Type checks pass (mypy)

- Regenerating an unchanged blueprint is idempotent (no spurious diffs)
- Tests pass (pytest)
- Lint passes (ruff)
- Type checks pass (mypy)
